# Hodlchi

> Hodlchi is the Duolingo of Money — hatch a cute virtual companion and grow it by completing short, beginner-friendly financial literacy lessons on saving, investing, credit, entrepreneurship, and crypto basics. Educational only; no trading, wallets, or investment advice.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page. What Hodlchi is and how the hatch → learn → feed → evolve loop works.
- [Financial Literacy for Teens](/financial-literacy-for-teens): Free gamified financial literacy course for teens and beginners — full curriculum overview.
- [Onboarding](/onboarding): Hatch a Hodlchi — pick an egg, name your companion, choose a personality.
- [Saving path](/path/saving): 4 short lessons on building the habit of keeping more than you spend.
- [Investing path](/path/investing): 4 short lessons on long-term investing basics and risk.
- [Credit path](/path/credit): 4 short lessons on credit scores, borrowing, and healthy credit habits.
- [Entrepreneurship path](/path/entrepreneurship): 4 short lessons on starting and running a small venture.
- [Crypto path](/path/crypto): 4 short lessons on crypto fundamentals from a neutral, educational angle.
